column1: # Danish (da) catalog for the whole CFA4 interface (Qt GUI and egui). Same format as es.tsv:
# context <TAB> source <TAB> translation.
# Clean-room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English label using ordinary
# Danish video-editing vocabulary (tidslinje, spor, klip, sekvens, mappe, afspilningshoved,
# markør, overgang, nøglebillede). No proprietary localisation resource, string table or product
# UI was consulted or copied; add entries the same way. Commands are imperatives ("Gem som…"),
# labels use sentence case, quotation marks are »…«, and product and format names (CFA4,
# Lumetri, ProRes, AAF, EDL…) keep their spelling. Decimal comma (0,5). A native-speaker review
# is welcome.
# Terms: clip = klip, track = spor, sequence = sekvens, timeline = tidslinje, bin = mappe,
# playhead = afspilningshoved, marker = markør, In/Out point = ind-/udpunkt, keyframe =
# nøglebillede, frame = billede, caption = undertekst, preset = forudindstilling, template =
# skabelon, workspace = arbejdsområde, gain = forstærkning, opacity = uigennemsigtighed, render =
# rendering, ripple = med forskydning, dissolve = overtoning, wipe = aftørring, voice-over =
# speak, proxy = proxy, guide = hjælpelinje, shortcut = genvej, (Legacy) = (ældre).
# Licence: GPL-3.0-or-later (CFA4 contributors), except the section imported from craft-i18n at
# the end (MIT OR Apache-2.0); see da.tsv.attribution.
